title: K8s Resource Input
summary: Reads Kubernetes CPU and memory requests back in plain units, so 500 meaning 500 cores or 400m meaning 0.4 bytes is caught before deploy.
description: Requests/limits fields that read values in plain units and catch CPU 500 meaning 500 cores, 400m memory meaning 0.4 bytes, unit-case slips, a limit under its request, CPU finer than 1m and requests above any node, with fixes, the QoS class and resources: paste.
catches: Memory 400m meaning 0.4 bytes, and MB/Gb style unit slips
A limit below its request (1G vs 1Gi)
CPU finer than 1m, which the API rounds
Requests larger than your biggest node
limits: Node size comes from the node prop; it doesn't query the cluster
Doesn't check LimitRanges, ResourceQuotas or ephemeral storage
QoS class is computed for this container only, not the whole pod
a11y: Each field has a visible label and is described by its plain-units readback
aria-invalid on flagged fields; status uses role=status
Focus returns to a nearby control after a fix

sources.label: Kubernetes: Resource Management for Pods and Containers

rules.note: Informational. Confirmed the case-sensitive suffix warning (400m of memory is 0.4 bytes). Rounding and QoS rules were not re-checked this round.

mistakes: mi vs mb in k8s yaml
